value.rationale: The exact theorem resolves a motivated robustness gap left at rate-bound level. It separates omission magnitude from alignment: two nonzero omissions can cancel exactly when orthogonal, while aligned omissions attain the product-error order. The root-n residual-correlation boundary is a concrete design diagnostic and the exact integral enables finite-sample stress testing.
